{{Quote|The next card, up above the Satellite, here, is supposed to tell us where we’ll find ourselves next. Hmmm. I wonder what that means?|Lando Calrissian|<ref name="Lando">''[[Lando Calrissian and the Mindharp of Sharu]]''</ref>}}
'''The Wheel''' was a [[Sabacc/Legends|sabacc]] card exclusive to the [[Centran sabacc/Legends|Centran]] variant of the game. As a face card, it only appeared once in the deck. In addition to being played, the card carried meaning in cartomancy. When drawn for the position representing where the subject would find themselves next, The Wheel denoted luck, both good and bad, the beginning and end of things, random chance, and final outcome.<ref name="Lando" />

*''[[Lando Calrissian and the Mindharp of Sharu]]'' {{1st}}
